description: Create HTTP client with connection pooling and circuit breaker for worker communication, plus the Dispatcher that routes requests. The client reuses patterns from internal/connect/resilience.go for circuit breaker. Dispatcher checks worker readiness, forwards ExecuteRequest to workers, handles timeouts, and propagates trace headers.
steps: Create /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-workers-phase3/engine/internal/gateway/client.go with WorkerClient struct containing: httpClient *http.Client (configured with connection pooling via Transport.MaxIdleConnsPerHost=10, Transport.IdleConnTimeout=90s), breakers map[string]*gobreaker.CircuitBreaker[*worker.ExecuteResponse] (one per group), mu sync.RWMutex, log observ.Logger. Methods: NewWorkerClient(log), Execute(ctx, endpoint, req *worker.ExecuteRequest) (*worker.ExecuteResponse, error), getBreaker(group) - creates breaker if not exists using same pattern as internal/connect/resilience.go newBreaker

Implement Execute method: 1) Get or create breaker for group, 2) breaker.Execute wraps the HTTP call, 3) Marshal ExecuteRequest to JSON, 4) POST to endpoint+'/execute' with Content-Type application/json, 5) Propagate X-Request-Id, X-Trace-Id, traceparent headers from context, 6) Parse ExecuteResponse from body, 7) Return classified error if response.Error is non-nil or HTTP status >= 400

Create /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-workers-phase3/engine/internal/gateway/circuit.go with BreakerConfig struct (FailureThreshold uint32 default 5, OpenTimeout time.Duration default 10s) and newGroupBreaker(group string, cfg BreakerConfig) function following internal/connect/resilience.go pattern

Create /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-workers-phase3/engine/internal/gateway/dispatcher.go with Dispatcher struct containing: registry *WorkerRegistry, client *WorkerClient, config *config.DispatchConfig, log observ.Logger. Methods: NewDispatcher(registry, client, config, log), Dispatch(ctx, flowID string, group string, input map[string]any) (*worker.ExecuteResponse, error)

Implement Dispatch method: 1) Lookup worker via registry.GetWorker(group), 2) Return error if worker not found or not ready (NO fallback per design), 3) Build ExecuteRequest with flowID, requestID from ctx, traceID from ctx, input, 4) Apply config.RequestTimeout via context.WithTimeout, 5) Call client.Execute, 6) Return response or classified error

Create /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-workers-phase3/engine/internal/gateway/client_test.go with tests: TestWorkerClient_Execute_Success verifies request marshaling and header propagation, TestWorkerClient_Execute_Timeout verifies timeout handling, TestWorkerClient_CircuitBreaker_Opens verifies breaker trips after consecutive failures

Create /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-workers-phase3/engine/internal/gateway/dispatcher_test.go with tests: TestDispatcher_WorkerNotFound returns error, TestDispatcher_WorkerNotReady returns error, TestDispatcher_Success forwards to client and returns response, TestDispatcher_Timeout propagates timeout error
acceptance_criteria: WorkerClient uses connection pooling via http.Transport settings
Circuit breaker trips after 5 consecutive failures (configurable)
Dispatcher returns error when worker not found (no fallback)
Trace headers propagated to worker requests
findings: Implemented WorkerClient with pooled HTTP transport (MaxIdleConnsPerHost=10, IdleConnTimeout=90s) and per-group circuit breakers using gobreaker/v2. BreakerConfig allows customizable failure threshold (default 5) and open timeout (default 10s). Dispatcher checks worker readiness and forwards requests to workers, propagating X-Request-Id, X-Trace-Id, and traceparent headers from observ.RequestScope. Both client and dispatcher return response along with error when worker returns error response, allowing callers to inspect error details. Added DispatchConfig for configurable request timeout (default 30s). All tests pass including edge cases for breaker open, timeout, and worker error propagation. Cross-FEAT verification passed: go mod tidy, go build ./cmd/engine, go build ./cmd/worker, go test ./... (12 packages pass), go vet ./... all succeed.
